Auspicious and approved are the eyes, O my soul, which see the saintly True Guru.
0BRP: Sacred and sanctified are those hands, O my soul, which write the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.
O my soul, sacred and sanctified are those hands, which write down the Lord's praise and the Lord's Name.
9G7Y: I worship continually the feet of that humble being, O my soul, who walks on the Path of Dharma - the path of righteousness.
I ever adore the feet of that person, O my soul, who walks on to the way of righteousness.
VAB6: Nanak is a sacrifice to those, O my soul, who hear of the Lord, and believe in the Lord's Name. ||3||
Nanak is a sacrifice to those, O my soul, who hear of God and believe in God's Name.
Q8Z6: The earth, the nether regions of the underworld, and the Akaashic ethers, O my soul, all meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
The earth, nether-world and firmament, O my soul, all meditate on the Lord master's Name.
3RVE: Wind, water and fire, O my soul, continually sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
The wind, the water and the fire, O my soul, ever hymn the praise of Lord God, the Master.
J9U5: The woods, the meadows and the whole world, O my soul, chant with their mouths the Lord's Name, and meditate on the Lord.
The woods, the grass blades and the whole world, O my soul, utter with their mouth the Lord Master's Name.
1R7M: O Nanak, one who, as Gurmukh, focuses his consciousness on the Lord's devotional worship - O my soul, he is robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||4||
Nanak, he who fixes his mind, through the Guru, on Lord's devotional service, O my soul, is robed in the God's court.
DSB1: Those who do not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul - those self-willed manmukhs are foolish and ignorant.
They, who remember not the Name of the Lord Master, O my soul, are perverse, stupid and ignorant.

X2GY: Those who attach their consciousness to emotional attachment and Maya, O my soul, depart regretfully in the end.
They who attach their mind to temporal love and worldly valuables, O my soul, regretfully depart in the end.
VRQN: They find no place of rest in the Court of the Lord, O my soul; those self-willed manmukhs are deluded by sin.
The perverse persons, who are deluded by sin, O my soul, find no place of rest in God's court.
2NMY: O servant Nanak, those who meet the Guru are saved, O my soul; chanting the Name of the Lord, they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Says slave Nanak, they who meet the Guru and meditate over God, are saved, O my soul, and are absorbed in God's Name.
V68T: Go, everyone, and meet the True Guru; O my soul, He implants the Name of the Lord, Har, har, within the heart.
Go you all and meet the True Guru, O my soul, who fixes the Lord God's Name in the heart.
ZGLB: Do not hesitate for an instant - meditate on the Lord, O my soul; who knows whether he shall draw another breath?
Make not a moment's delay in contemplating over God, O my soul, as who knows whether mortal shall draw or draw not another breath?
6FXP: That time, that moment, that instant, that second is so fruitful, O my soul, when my Lord comes into my mind.
That time, that instant, that moment and that trice are profitable, O my soul, when my God comes into my mind.
H2WG: Servant Nanak has meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my soul, and now, the Messenger of Death does not draw near him. ||2||
Attendant Nanak has meditated on the Lord's name, O my soul and now, the death's myrmidon draws not near him.
CU6D: The Lord continually watches, and hears everything, O my soul; he alone is afraid, who commits sins.
God ever beholds and hears everything, O my soul and he alone is afraid who commits sins.
W7PX: One whose heart is pure within, O my soul, casts off all his fears.
The man, whose heart is pure from within him, O my soul, casts off all his fears.
FCPM: One who has faith in the Fearless Name of the Lord, O my soul - all his enemies and attackers speak against him in vain.
All the villains and contendents prate in vain against him, O my soul, who has faith in the Lord's fearless Name.
